steps.text: Bob, I've given your generous offer in your last letter some serious thought. While I do appreciate your gesture, I won't be departing for Columbia just yet.
We've decided to stay in a settlement outside Kazdel for now, to give our legs a rest.
It's true, we came a long, long way—literally one foot into Kazdel before turning around.
We hesitated, pondered, even argued... but we could neither enter nor leave Kazdel. None of us can quite say why.
Perhaps I still haven't made up my mind.
Perhaps the changes in Kazdel haven't made it that much better.
Or perhaps most of us simply don't have it in us to start another long journey.
On another note, we have a favor to ask. It embarrasses me to say, and I'm unsure if this even falls under your services.
Since this might prove troublesome, please allow me to apologize in advance. All that said, if possible, my friends and I...
...would like some beer.
If a regular supply is unlikely, at least bring some for Sauin Day? We're hoping to join the costume parade and really need some beers for that.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*... Goddamn choking here.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: You're wearing a mask.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Doesn't keep out dust. Go bother Liza if you must, Jürgen. She's covered from head to toe.

spans.text: Doesn't keep out dust. Go bother Liza if you must,
. She's covered from head to toe.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Mudrock, welcome back! Is the letter mailed? Can you say if we'll get the beer before Sauin or not?

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Mudrock. The beer?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: There was no Messenger. I had to give it to the Rhodes Island Office, for them to forward.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: That's gonna drag things out some more...

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: You can't find a single bottle of beer anywhere in Kazdel?

spans.text: You can't find a single bottle of beer

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: (Shrug) Why else would Mudrock write to Big Bob about it?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Dammit, no. We promised her we'd drink beer on Sauin, so we're getting it. We've got to do this ourselves.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are you suggesting we... brew beer?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: He's talking out of his ass. Like hell it's that simple to brew.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Oh, you'd know ass-talk, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Brewing's not even that hard. Steep barley in water to get the malt. Then you mash it, lauter it, add the hops, and then let it ferment.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: We have all the ingredients, except the hops...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We can look around. Brewing's easy according to him, right? He must know what hops look like.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: I do, thank you!

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: But if you ask me, why are you all on board now? Five seconds ago you said I was talking—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Shut your trap, Jürgen, I'm gonna go tell everyone we're brewing.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: You hear that, Jürgen? It's happening. You better hold up your end.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Aah, well, see, hahaha...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll make it with you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We all will.
A few days later...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...No, hops are nothing like this.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: How about these?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: (Sniff) No. That's sourer than Homburg's socks.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Some place Kazdel turned out to—uh, I mean, where we're camping is insanely barren. You made it sound different on the journey.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But I don't... recall saying Kazdel was lush with plants.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Was it someone else who said that? I think it was by the Winterwisp Mountains, during a snowy night...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No, never mind.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: No... You're right.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: It was snowing that day and we were starving like mad, but the nearby villagers already picked all the wild radishes clean...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: We were hungry and shivering in this rundown shack when Anya started it. She said at least Kazdel would have wild radishes. We then listed every nice place we could think of.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Lush hills, thick rainforests, fertile valleys cut with rivers... oh, and how could I forget, fields of barley and hops. That couldn't be Kazdel in a million years.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Jürgen, if you want to enter Kazdel—

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Then I can, I know. But I rather not sneak down the streets like a rat.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Not it. No. Not it—

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Haha, speak of the dev... *cough* delicious radish!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are you sure they're wild radishes?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Yup, and as many as you want! I guess Kazdel heard us back then!

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: *Leithanian swearing* you've got wild radish, now just give us some hops for crying out loud!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Let's just keep looking—

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Wait, Mudrock, hold still.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Some kind of cone just fell on your head. I'll grab it, don't move or it'll fall.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Got it. Now, what are you... Let me take a whiff...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: You're it, I think. This might just do.
Ten days later...

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Mudrock, what brings you here?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Everyone wants to hear how the beer is doing, so I came to see.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: It's doing, duh. It's fermenting.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: It's insane to me that Jürgen's not a total write-off. He looks competent while he's malting and boiling. Fermentation just stumps him, though, so I have to step in.

spans.text: It's insane to me that Jürgen's not a total write-off. He looks
while he's malting and boiling. Fermentation just stumps him, though, so I have to step in.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I thought he was the only one left in our squad who could brew.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Hello? Forgetting someone?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You—Um...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yes. You brewed a wonderful wildberry wine in the tundra.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Here I thought you forgot. Berry wine... That was years ago. We were still in Reunion, weren't we?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Mm. They called you Liza the 'Sugarlips' and 'Cherry Fangs'.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Hah! Guess it's all flooding back to you.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Liking my liquor on the sweeter side's no crime. How did 'Sugarlip' even stick? Am I that much of a sweet-talker?

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Cherry Fangs, though, that was perfect.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Your teeth were constantly stained red with berries—I remember. Though you were always wearing a mask.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Hahaha, look who's talking.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: You know, those times when we gave each other nicknames, joked around, and got drunk without any fighting sure passed quickly.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: You decided to leave right around that time, right?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: At first, out in the tundra, Reunion felt like a house with a warm hearth. Like a... home.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But as time went by, it turned into a raging, charging tank, burning everything in its path: snow, trees... even the earth.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: That's why, besides your usual Sarkaz pals, a few Ursus outcasts chose to tag along when you up and left.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: And that's also why Leithanians like Jürgen and Anya chose to stick it out with us. Because of you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Nothing to be sorry about.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: I know. You want Kazdel to be a home to us all, and yet we're not even getting into the city for Sauin fun times.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: But so what? We're outcasts from our own homes anyway, right? Doesn't seem too bad to be permanent, unwanted guests at Kazdel.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: I mean, we wouldn't even come to this Sauin thing if Anya—

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: *clicks tongue* Goddamn fermenter bin sprung a gas leak again. I'll patch it.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Crap, there's too much pressure!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll help!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: No, we can't let any soil get in! Let me—

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Goddamn homburg-wearing son of a bitch, couldn't find a worse bin if he tried!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Mudrock, are you—oh, you're okay. You're covered up even tighter than me.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Oof, it's time I get my own suit of armor. I'll start with the face. Maybe I'll just use Homburg's...

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It smells nice.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Now that you mentioned it... yeah. It does.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But—our ingredients...

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Relax, we just need new malt, and I know Jürgen has a whole secret stash of hops. He can't hide jack from me.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Secret stash? What for?

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: You'd never guess—it's his pillow stuffing.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: He sleeps like a log every night on it. Snores louder than an Originium buzzsaw.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Oh right. Want some berries?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Berries?

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: I traded for some from a caravan while buying yeast. Was going to brew berry wine after the beer fermented, but they weren't even sweet. Just good for eating.
As she speaks, the Ursus woman lifts a corner of her mask and pops a berry in her mouth.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Bleugh, no flavor at all.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: I'd take the tundra's berries in a heartbeat.
Weeks later...
Sauin Day

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock, the parade's starting soon. We'd better get ready. How's Jürgen and Liza's end? Is the beer done?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We'll find out very soon.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: And just in case, how about Big Bob?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Still no word.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Why are you just standing there?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'm thinking... about Kazdel.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's there to think about when you're already here? Look, the big ol' furnace is right there.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But is this Kazdel... really the very same place we'd been heading for?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Clearly it's not.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: A lot of it was Anya, you know, puffing Kazdel up to kingdom come as we went. Made me cringe to listen to.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But if Kazdel really was like that, I sure don't mind living in it for a few days—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Okay, let's get back to camp. I'm dying to drink some beer here.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Did it not work?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Well, not exactly, it's just—how do we put this...

spans.text: , it's just—how do we put this...

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Don't bother, just show them our magnum opus. Here, try just a shot to start.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It smells great—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Urp...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...It's vinegar.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: *chuckle*

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: You're laughing?

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: What else am I supposed to do? Cry? You think Anya wants to see you cry?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ANYA IS NOT—

a.text: 'I'm the first of the Mudrock Squad to die in Kazdel. It is a comfort to die in my homeland. When I'm gone, please scatter my ashes into the sea—'
'...You're not really thinking of going to Iberia, are you? I've heard the rumors, and I refuse to become Seaborn food!'
'I'll settle for the next best thing. How about you place my remains in the Soul Furnace? That must be a first for a Caprinae, right—'
'Gosh, can't you guys tell when I'm joking? Don't tell me you were seriously considering going against all of Kazdel?'
'Okay, I'll be serious now. I hear there will be a costume parade outside the city during Sauin Day.'
'I want all of you to go. Go have a good time, see the sights, and drink some beer. Not that awful Kazdel moonshine, but real beer. And when you do, just take me along, and I'll be happy.'
'...All I did was mention beer, and now all of you are drooling? What happened to feeling sad for me? Mudrock, at least promise me you'll get these poor suckers some beer on Sauin Day, okay?'
'It's been so long since we remembered how to laugh...'

steps.text: The Leithanian stares at his ex-Reunion squadmate—
—and abruptly snatches the drink out of Mudrock's hands, downing the vinegar in one clean gulp.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Jürgen!

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Mudrock, it's fine, I'm great—*ghaack*!

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: I'm telling you, Liza. I'm going to Kazdel today, and I'll be there in the parade...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...Drinking sparkling vinegar!
The tense atmosphere instantly relaxes and pockets of laughter can be heard from the group.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Jürgen said it. Let's pick up Anya, and our 'beer'... and go to Kazdel.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Shame, I thought we'd really get to drink beer. Any word from Big Bob?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's getting dark. We can't afford to wait for him anymore.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Everyone, get yourselves ready. We're going to Kazdel now.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Today is Sauin. Since we'll be going to a costume parade, I suggest you all... erm...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Get creative.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'm not sure if the other Sarkaz there will object to our presence, so, I'd disguise as close to a Sarkaz as you can to be safe.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The other Sarkaz and I will lead the way for you.

steps.name: Feline Squadmember
steps.text: Look at my handcrafted fake horns. Aren't they just so realistic? Step up, step up, I'll crown anyone without their own!

steps.name: Ursus Squadmember
steps.text: You call this handiwork? I can't even get it on my ears!

steps.name: Feline Squadmember
steps.text: My handiwork is just fine! It's not my fault your ears are too round!

steps.name: Caprinae Squadmember
steps.text: What about me, then? I'm not sanding my horns! You don't know how much it hurts!

steps.name: Sarkaz Squadmember
steps.text: Costume, think costume! Just put on a hat or something and you're safe!

steps.name: Elafia Squadmember
steps.text: I hear some of the city folk dress up as Sankta too. Here, stick this halo on your head.

steps.name: Sarkaz Squadmember
steps.text: Liiiike... *Sarkaz swearing*, this thing glows HARD!

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: Look, it's Mudrock's gang.

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter B
steps.text: They always have that many Sarkaz? Don't the horns on that one look... wonky?

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter B
steps.text: And look at those horns poking out of the hat. That's a Caprinae for sure...

steps.name: Sarkaz Squadmember
steps.text: Hey, forget them, check me out!

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: Oh, we're getting to you. Tell me, what's a real Sarkaz doing with a HALO?

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter B
steps.text: Isn't this all a bit too—

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: Nah, it's all good. If they got horns, then they're Sarkaz!

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter B
steps.text: But she hasn't got—

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: It's called commitment! Sorry you can't appreciate an authentic Reunion costume!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: You get it!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Here, take a swig, I guarantee it'll knock you off your feet!

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: Beer? Beer this bubbly? Damn, I haven't had a drink in forever, let me get a taste of that—

spans.text: bubbly? Damn, I haven't had a drink in forever, let me get a taste of that—

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: PWFFFT—that's vinegar!

steps.name: Paraders
steps.text: *hearty laughter*
The Sarkaz who can't or won't enter Kazdel all seem to notice this ragtag band of misfits.
Given the limitations, most of the Mudrock Squad's disguises are far too easy to see through.
But on this night, everyone rather pretend that they don't know.
Just like they rather believe that these outlanders are the same as them, having come a long, long back home...
Back to Kazdel.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Hahaha... *burp*!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Jürgen, enough. Quit pouring vinegar down your stomach.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: What's this about vinegar? If I say it's beer, it's beer!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Jürgen...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Hey, Mudrock! We're having a good time, right? Like Anya said?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: What do you think, Anya? Is this what you had in mind?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's getting late. It's time we moved on to the last thing.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...What's that?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We're... going to Kazdel.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: It's fine, though. Even Anya said it's not worth it to go against the entire city just for her...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It'll be okay.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Let me... take Anya.
The Leithanian passes the urn to Mudrock.
She stands firm.
The night wind whistles around her, but she remains silent, like a boulder.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Kazdel doesn't just have to be where the Soul Furnace is.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The soils, the bogs, and the sands. Perhaps in those serene, expansive, and peaceful places, can we find our true Kazdel...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Our true home.
The group simmers down. Quietly, they wait.
Until Mudrock places the urn down, and murmurs faint words to the earth.
Until the earth tremors and the mud and rocks answer her call, forming a furnace roughly the height of a person, as they have done for Mudrock countless times during the journey here.
Until firewood is placed in the furnace and a modest flame is kindled, there is no wailing or bellowing—only the soft crackling of the firewood.
Mudrock.
Mudrock!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Is that you...?!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I didn't expect you'd be all the way out here. You sure gave me some trouble.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Nice seeing you again, Mudrock.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Bob?! It really is you—you came!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I got held up a little on the way, but I made sure I got here just on time.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: But your camp was empty when I got there, so I was worried something happened. Good thing I haven't lost all my skills from my bounty hunter days—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Bob!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Big Bob! You actually came!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I had to. The Mudrock Squad wants beer, and who am I to say no?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: So you're... Big Bob? You brought us beer... for real?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Oh, are you the new guy?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You got it. Everyone, I give you, beer!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Bob's Farm special brew, brought to you by courtesy of the owner, and enough for the whole Mudrock Squad.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: But judging by the mood, now's not a good time to pop caps?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No, no...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Bob, the timing is perfect. Now's the right time... for some beer.
Mudrock opens the urn and scatters the ashes of a warrior who has traveled a long way home into the flames.
Then, she takes a beer from Big Bob.
She pours the golden, foamy liquid into the furnace, causing a few cracks and bangs, echoing like the laughter of a friend who arrived too late for the Sauin parade.

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: (Sniffle)

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Damn the smoke's choking, right?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Yeah, and you all know how my mask... doesn't block dust.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Anya... Anya...
Sobs can be heard from the Mudrock Squad as the remaining paraders gather by the furnace.
Watching the dancing flames, each one reflects on those who should have been here but are no longer.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...Bob, got more beer?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Plenty more.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Gimme one! I'm not gonna let Anya drink the lot!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Everyone... come get your bottle.

steps.name: Kazdelian Outskirter A
steps.text: Uh, if you have any spare...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Here!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: My Originium refrigeration broke down on the road anyway! With this much to drink, the Mudrock Squad is gonna need all your help!
The cold beers work their magic, and the tears soon stop.
Stiff upper lips relax, and tipsy faces flush with red. Sobbing turns to singing, which blossoms into hearty conversations.
The aroma of hops drifts into the darkness, where the souls slumber.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Mudrock! If you can make shelters and Colossi out of earth, you think you can uh... *burp* make something... uhh... poetic?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Poetic?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Like—if you turn all this Kazdelian wasteland into soil so dark and rich you could drink it—that's right... turn it into a barley field!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Turn it into a berry orchard!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I vote barley field.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: See—see!

steps.name: Ursus Caster
steps.text: Homburg, think carefully! The only thing Jürgen can brew is sparkling vinegar! If I get my orchard, I promise you'll have berry wine every single day!

steps.name: Gleeful Crowd
steps.text: BER-RY WINE! BER-RY WINE!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Bob, thank you. We couldn't have done this without you.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: No. Something tells me, even without any beer to save you from drinking piss, it's still a cozy Sauin tonight.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Also, I'm sorry. I wrote before that I'd visit you in Columbia, but now you had to come to Kazdel first.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Nah, I kinda like it here. Columbia's got the wheat fields and the hops, but there's also the ATAO...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The... ATAO?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units and Originium. In short, pesky taxmen who won't give me a break.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I thought about sending someone to deliver the beers, but I needed some time away from the ATAO. Plus, had to make sure nothing went wrong with the beers.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Besides, you did ask me for a sample of hops, right? Figured I'd just bring you a whole truck of beer.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But what will happen when you get back...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Who knows! Those hounds love to bite. They might have me arrested the second I'm back on Columbian soil! Haha!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: What about you? You and your crew gonna bunk here for good?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No. There'll be a day when we leave, when we resist.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Against who?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Ursus's lords, Leithanien's nobles... No, not just them.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Oh, music to my ears. Can you put the ATAO on your list?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (Smiles) Assuming we do go to Columbia.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But truth be told, it's a lot harder resisting the things you have to... than the things you choose to.
The two fall silent, while over by the furnace, the lively banter carries on.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But for now, at least, the fact that we're still alive, carrying our dreams and memories, and laughing from our hearts—it's our own, small way of resisting.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: In our collective home.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: In Kazdel.
